summary: Review secrets and configuration handling for source exposure, environment separation, defaults, rotation compatibility and logging boundaries.

must_inspect.why: Secrets should not be committed, embedded in artifacts or emitted in logs/errors.
false_positive_guards: A secret-like test fixture is not a production credential without provenance evidence.

must_inspect.why: Configuration should not accidentally point development/test paths at production resources or vice versa.
false_positive_guards: Do not infer environment mix-up from naming alone.

must_inspect.why: Secret/config rotation and missing-value behavior should fail in a bounded way.
false_positive_guards: Do not demand hot rotation unless operational requirements need it.
Never reproduce detected credentials in report evidence.
handoff_triggers: Secret revocation/incident response -> dedicated operational workflow
